column1: # MCP configs at home: the app, its id in data/mcp-clients.tsv, and where its config is. A project's
# own configs (.mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json) are found by the home scan. One line each,
# tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
# Devin Desktop, Windsurf renamed, keeps its MCP config in ~/.codeium (docs.devin.ai/desktop/devin-desktop-faq).
#   app     the app's name in the report
#   sh      the config for gird-check.sh: from ~, {AS} (Application Support, or the place the OS
#   ps      the config for gird-check.ps1: from ~, {APPDATA} or {LOCALAPPDATA}
